'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**A Hezbollah and PIJ militant killed in [[Aedsheet]] and [[Blida]], [[Marjeyoun District]], two civilian cell tower repairers killed [[Tayr Harfa]] in Israeli airstrikes.[https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2024/05/10/israel-strike-on-south-lebanon-kills-two-report (Al Arabiya)]

*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[2024 Kharkiv offensive]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] launch an attack on [[Ukraine]]'s [[Kharkiv Oblast]], near the town of [[Vovchansk]], opening up a new front. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukraine-sends-reinforcements-after-russian-forces-attack-kharkiv-region-2024-05-10/ (Reuters)]
**A Ukrainian strike against oil infrastructure kills three in [[Luhansk]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukrainian-attack-kills-three-sparks-fire-oil-depot-luhansk-russia-installed-2024-05-10/ (Reuters)]
*[[M23 offensive (2022–present)|M23 offensive]]
**The death toll from rocket strikes on an [[Internally displaced person|IDP camp]] in [[Goma]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], increases to 35. [https://apnews.com/article/congo-bombing-displaced-people-death-toll-m23-a7092797e8d9b921b039404692a2b28f (AP)]
*[[Insurgency in Cabo Delgado]]
**Hundreds of [[Islamic State – Central Africa Province|Islamic State]]-linked fighters attack the town of [[Macomia]], [[Cabo Delgado Province]], [[Mozambique]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/10/mozambiques-president-says-northern-town-under-attack-by-armed-groups (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Naxalite–Maoist insurgency]]
**[[India]]n security forces kill 12 [[Maoist]] rebels in [[Chhattisgarh]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/indian-security-forces-kill-least-12-maoist-rebels-gunbattle-2024-05-10/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Afghanistan–Pakistan floods]]
**Over 200 people are killed by [[flood]]s in [[Baghlan Province]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/over-200-dead-many-houses-damaged-in-afghanistan-flash-floods-in-baghlan-province-report-5638695 (NDTV)]
*[[2024 Rio Grande do Sul floods]]
**The death toll from the ongoing heavy flooding in southern [[Brazil]] increases to 126, with 141 still missing and more than 300,000 people displaced. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/death-toll-floods-southern-brazil-hits-113-2024-05-10/ (Reuters)]
*Seven people are killed and six others are injured when a passenger bus plunges from the [[Potseluev Bridge]] into the [[Moyka]] river in [[Saint Petersburg]], [[Russia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/bus-falls-into-river-russias-st-petersburg-2024-05-10/ (Reuters)]
*At least 60 people are injured when a passenger train collides with a locomotive in [[Buenos Aires]], [[Argentina]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/sixty-injured-buenos-aires-train-collision-2024-05-10/ (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Demographics of Italy]]
**Amid record low [[birth rates]] and an [[aging population]], [[Pope Francis]] urges [[Italy|Italians]] to have more children. The Italian government also expands a campaign to encourage at least 500,000 births annually by 2033. [https://apnews.com/article/vatican-demographics-meloni-pope-67a727125061a948d29af57186748e93 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Palestine and the United Nations]]
**[[United Nations General Assembly Resolution ES-10/23]]
***The [[United Nations General Assembly]] votes 143–9 with 25 abstentions to approve a resolution granting [[Palestinian territories|Palestine]] new rights and privileges, and to reconsider Palestine's request to become a UN member. The nine countries that opposed the resolution were  [[Argentina]], the [[Czech Republic]], [[Hungary]], [[Israel]], [[Federated States of Micronesia|Micronesia]], [[Nauru]], [[Palau]], [[Papua New Guinea]] and the [[United States]]. [https://apnews.com/article/un-resolution-palestinians-membership-rights-us-assembly-875560e897f27d6600090420f36404e4 (AP)] [https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/2024/05/10/un-general-assembly-votes-in-favour-of-palestinian-bid-for-full-membership/ (''The National'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**[[Catatumbo campaign]]
***A [[Colombia]]n court in [[Bogotá]] grants [[conditional release]] to former paramilitary leader [[Salvatore Mancuso]]. He was held at La Picota prison while being accused of [[war crimes]] and [[human rights]] violations. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/colombia-paramilitary-leader-salvatore-mancuso-released-by-bogota-court-2024-05-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[Arrest of Arvind Kejriwal]], [[2024 Indian general election]]
**The [[Supreme Court of India]] grants [[List of chief ministers of Delhi|Delhi Chief Minister]] [[Arvind Kejriwal]] interim bail for 21 days in connection with the [[Delhi liquor scam|Delhi liquor policy]] money laundering case, thereby permitting Kejriwal to campaign in the ongoing general election. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/arvind-kejriwal-hearing-live-updates-supreme-court-may-10-delhi-excise-policy-aap-manish-sisodia-liquor-policy-101715301901261.html (''The Hindustan Times'')]
*A [[Pennsylvania]] jury orders [[ExxonMobil]] to pay $725.5 million to a former mechanic who claimed that the company's gasoline and solvents caused him to develop [[leukemia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/legal/exxon-hit-with-7255-million-verdict-over-mechanics-leukemia-diagnosis-2024-05-10/ (Reuters)]
*[[Peru]]vian authorities launch an investigation into [[President of Peru|President]] [[Dina Boluarte]] for disbanding a police force that was investigating her brother Nicanor Boluarte, who was arrested for alleged [[influence peddling]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/peruvian-presidents-brother-arrested-rolex-scandal-probe-2024-05-10/ (Reuters)]

***[[Robert F. Kennedy Jr.]] qualifies to appear on the ballot in [[Oklahoma]] for the 2024 United States presidential election as an independent candidate. [https://www.yahoo.com/news/robert-f-kennedy-files-run-213953172.html (Yahoo! News)]
*[[2024 Polish farmers' protests]]
**Thousands of protesters march through [[Warsaw]], [[Poland]], against the [[European Union]]'s environmental regulations. [https://www.euronews.com/green/2024/05/10/polish-farmers-stage-parliament-sit-in-against-ukraine-imports-and-eu-regulations (Euronews)]
